doc.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007

title: Trad jazz versus classic jazz
summary: He distinguishes loose trad jazz from classic jazz as a study of recordings and solos.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels

blocks.x: And I don’t know if this is a good question or not. Trad jazz and classic jazz — is there a difference for you?

There shouldn’t be. I mean trad jazz to a lot of people is a little bit more freer and as far as less attention to details as I think classic jazz is. Classic jazz to me is a real study of the music and whether it’s recreating certain recordings and the solos and analyzing it. To me the trad jazz idea is let’s get together and have a good time and just blow and we’re not going to be too picky.
